title: Local Food Walking Tours in Salt Lake City
includes: Guest will receive food tasting at 4 different restaurants in downtown Salt Lake City.
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: "Embark on a culinary adventure through Utah's vibrant cities with Local Food Walking Tours. Established in 2019, these tours seamlessly blend historical insights, architectural wonders, and delectable flavors, offering a unique immersion into the region's rich tapestry. Explore Salt Lake City's bustling downtown or stroll along Park City's charming Main Street, savoring gourmet delights from beloved local eateries. Each bite unveils a story, each step uncovers hidden gems, transforming every tour into an unforgettable gastronomic escapade."
